analysis.uncertainty: Direction is not automatically good or bad, and this briefing cannot identify causes. 5 comparison(s) lack sufficient evidence.

active_stake_sol.caveat: Vote accounts are not necessarily distinct operators or organizations.
active_stake_sol.definition: Activated stake assigned to currently active vote accounts.
active_stake_sol.label: Active stake
active_stake_sol.why_it_matters: It shows how much voting power is currently participating.

active_validators.caveat: A validator count does not describe how evenly stake is distributed.
active_validators.definition: Vote accounts currently classified as active by the RPC response.
active_validators.label: Active validators
active_validators.why_it_matters: Active vote accounts show how many validators are currently participating, before considering stake concentration.

agave_latest_stable_release_age_days.caveat: A recent release is not automatically safe or widely adopted, and release age is not a developer-count metric.
agave_latest_stable_release_age_days.definition: Elapsed days since the newest non-draft, non-prerelease Agave release.
agave_latest_stable_release_age_days.label: Latest stable Agave release age

source.method: GitHub releases; latest stable tag v4.2.0
source.name: Anza Agave GitHub releases

agave_latest_stable_release_age_days.why_it_matters: Release recency is one bounded sign of maintained core software.

agave_stable_releases_90d.caveat: Release count is not adoption, code quality, contributor count, or proof that validators upgraded.
agave_stable_releases_90d.definition: Non-draft, non-prerelease Agave releases published in the trailing 90 days.
agave_stable_releases_90d.label: Stable Agave releases in 90 days

source.method: GitHub releases; stable releases; trailing 90 days
source.name: Anza Agave GitHub releases

agave_stable_releases_90d.why_it_matters: Release cadence shows whether core client work is shipping publicly.

alpenglow_upgrade_status.caveat: Roadmap dates can move; announced development is not mainnet activation.
alpenglow_upgrade_status.definition: Current phase and expected activation window shown on Solana's official upgrade page.
alpenglow_upgrade_status.label: Alpenglow upgrade status
alpenglow_upgrade_status.why_it_matters: It tracks the named consensus upgrade without implying that a roadmap date is guaranteed.

block_height.caveat: This is network progress, not a measure of user adoption.
block_height.definition: Current block height reported by the selected RPC node.
block_height.label: Block height
block_height.why_it_matters: Block height is a second progress marker that helps detect a stalled or lagging data source.

current_slot.caveat: Different RPC nodes can be a few slots apart.
current_slot.definition: Latest slot reported by the selected public RPC node.
current_slot.label: Current slot
current_slot.why_it_matters: A rising slot confirms that this observer sees the chain continuing to advance.

daily_jupiter_fee_payer_overlap.caveat: This is an address intersection, not a count of people; sponsored or relayed transactions can fall outside it. Automatic refresh note: The saved Dune result is preserved but needs a fresh query execution.
daily_jupiter_fee_payer_overlap.definition: Jupiter Swap signer addresses that were also the successful transaction fee payer on the same UTC day.
daily_jupiter_fee_payer_overlap.label: Jupiter signer and fee-payer overlap
daily_jupiter_fee_payer_overlap.why_it_matters: The overlap reveals how often the visible application signer also pays the transaction fee.

daily_unique_jupiter_swap_signers.caveat: Wallet addresses are not people, and this measures Jupiter Swap signers rather than users of a particular wallet app. Automatic refresh note: The saved Dune result is preserved but needs a fresh query execution.
daily_unique_jupiter_swap_signers.definition: Distinct tx_signer addresses on intended swaps recorded by Dune's curated Jupiter aggregator table during the latest complete UTC day.
daily_unique_jupiter_swap_signers.label: Daily unique Jupiter Swap signers
daily_unique_jupiter_swap_signers.why_it_matters: It shows the scale of intended swap activity through one of Solana's major application routes.

daily_unique_successful_fee_payers.caveat: Wallet addresses are not people: one person or bot can control many addresses, and relayers may pay fees for others. Automatic refresh note: The saved Dune result is preserved but needs a fresh query execution.
daily_unique_successful_fee_payers.definition: Distinct primary signer (fee payer) addresses on successful non-vote Solana transactions during the latest complete UTC day.
daily_unique_successful_fee_payers.label: Daily unique successful fee payers
daily_unique_successful_fee_payers.why_it_matters: Fee payers approximate how many distinct addresses initiated successful activity and paid for execution.

daily_unique_successful_signers.caveat: Wallet addresses are not people: one person or bot can control many addresses, and one transaction may require several signers. Automatic refresh note: The saved Dune result is preserved but needs a fresh query execution.
daily_unique_successful_signers.definition: Distinct signer addresses on successful non-vote Solana transactions during the latest complete UTC day.
daily_unique_successful_signers.label: Daily unique successful signers
daily_unique_successful_signers.why_it_matters: Successful signers capture a broader set of participating addresses than fee payers alone.

delinquent_stake_share_pct.caveat: One RPC snapshot can change quickly as validators recover or fall behind.
delinquent_stake_share_pct.definition: Delinquent activated stake as a share of all activated stake in this response.
delinquent_stake_share_pct.label: Delinquent stake share
delinquent_stake_share_pct.why_it_matters: Stake share is more meaningful than a raw delinquent-validator count.

delinquent_stake_sol.caveat: Delinquency can be temporary and does not imply malicious behavior.
delinquent_stake_sol.definition: Activated stake assigned to vote accounts currently classified as delinquent.
delinquent_stake_sol.label: Delinquent stake
delinquent_stake_sol.why_it_matters: It sizes the voting power currently failing to participate normally.

delinquent_validators.caveat: Temporary delinquency can recover and is not automatically malicious behavior.
delinquent_validators.definition: Vote accounts currently classified as delinquent by the RPC response.
delinquent_validators.label: Delinquent validators
delinquent_validators.why_it_matters: Delinquency is an early operational signal that part of the validator set is falling behind.

epoch_progress.caveat: Epoch progress describes validator timing, not economic growth.
epoch_progress.definition: Share of the current epoch's slots already completed.
epoch_progress.label: Epoch progress
epoch_progress.why_it_matters: Epoch progress provides timing context for validator rewards, stake activation, and network operations.

estimated_median_transaction_fee_lamport.caveat: This is an estimate for a one-signature transaction using one RPC node's recent cache, not the median fee of every executed transaction.
estimated_median_transaction_fee_lamport.definition: One-signature base fee plus the median recent prioritization fee reported by the selected RPC node.
estimated_median_transaction_fee_lamport.label: Estimated median transaction fee
estimated_median_transaction_fee_lamport.why_it_matters: It provides a bounded, user-scale fee benchmark alongside aggregate chain fees.

estimated_non_vote_tps.caveat: Non-vote transactions can still include bots and automated programs.
estimated_non_vote_tps.definition: Non-vote transactions in the latest RPC performance sample divided by sample seconds.
estimated_non_vote_tps.label: Estimated non-vote TPS
estimated_non_vote_tps.why_it_matters: This is the closest live RPC measure of application and user transaction throughput.

estimated_non_vote_tps_vs_recent_median_.caveat: The RPC sample window is short and non-vote transactions can include automation.
estimated_non_vote_tps_vs_recent_median_.definition: Latest non-vote TPS relative to the median of earlier RPC performance samples.
estimated_non_vote_tps_vs_recent_median_.label: Non-vote TPS vs recent sample median
estimated_non_vote_tps_vs_recent_median_.why_it_matters: It detects short-run throughput drops or spikes without calling them good or bad.

estimated_slot_time.caveat: This is a short recent estimate and can move between samples.
estimated_slot_time.definition: Latest performance sample duration divided by slots produced.
estimated_slot_time.label: Estimated slot time
estimated_slot_time.why_it_matters: Slot time indicates how quickly the chain is advancing in the most recent sample.

estimated_slot_time_vs_recent_median_pct.caveat: This compares a bounded set of recent samples from one RPC endpoint.
estimated_slot_time_vs_recent_median_pct.definition: Latest estimated slot time relative to the median of earlier RPC performance samples.
estimated_slot_time_vs_recent_median_pct.label: Slot time vs recent sample median
estimated_slot_time_vs_recent_median_pct.why_it_matters: It detects a short-run slowdown in chain progression.

estimated_tps.caveat: Includes validator votes, so it is not the same as user activity.
estimated_tps.definition: All transactions in the latest RPC performance sample divided by sample seconds.
estimated_tps.label: Estimated total TPS
estimated_tps.why_it_matters: Total throughput shows network load, but must be separated from user activity because it includes validator votes.

jupiter_swap_signer_7d_return_rate.caveat: Returning addresses are not necessarily returning people; bots and one person using several wallets remain included. Automatic refresh note: The saved Dune result is preserved but needs a fresh query execution.
jupiter_swap_signer_7d_return_rate.definition: Share of the day's Jupiter Swap signer addresses also seen at least once during the preceding seven complete UTC days.
jupiter_swap_signer_7d_return_rate.label: Jupiter Swap seven-day return rate
jupiter_swap_signer_7d_return_rate.why_it_matters: Return rate distinguishes repeat use from one-time address activity.

latest_official_solana_news_age_days.caveat: This is one official editorial feed, not a complete view of community news or sentiment.
latest_official_solana_news_age_days.definition: Elapsed days since the newest item in Solana's official RSS feed.
latest_official_solana_news_age_days.label: Latest official Solana news age

source.method: RSS latest item: Why Asia Is Ahead on Stablecoins, According to Reap's Daren Guo
source.name: Official Solana source

latest_official_solana_news_age_days.why_it_matters: It keeps current ecosystem developments visible without treating social sentiment as fact.

median_commission_pct.caveat: The median does not include operating cost, MEV, or total validator profitability.
median_commission_pct.definition: Median advertised commission among active vote accounts with valid values.
median_commission_pct.label: Median validator commission
median_commission_pct.why_it_matters: Commission affects how staking rewards are divided between validators and delegators.

rpc_health.caveat: This checks one public RPC endpoint, not every validator.
rpc_health.definition: Health response from the selected public RPC node.
rpc_health.label: RPC health
rpc_health.why_it_matters: It is the first check that the dashboard's live network data path is responding normally.

simd_0525_status.caveat: A SIMD status is not proof that code is deployed or activated on mainnet.
simd_0525_status.definition: Current status declared in the official SIMD-0525 proposal for staged shorter slots.
simd_0525_status.label: SIMD-0525 shorter-slot proposal
simd_0525_status.why_it_matters: It tracks a sponsor-named proposal that could materially change Solana latency.

sol_price_24h_change_pct.caveat: A price move does not explain network health or user adoption.
sol_price_24h_change_pct.label: SOL 24-hour price change
sol_price_24h_change_pct.why_it_matters: It supplies a bounded price-move signal for anomaly review.

sol_price_usd.caveat: Market price is volatile context, not evidence that network or application usage is growing.
sol_price_usd.definition: CoinGecko's aggregated market price for one SOL in USD.
sol_price_usd.label: SOL price
sol_price_usd.why_it_matters: Price supplies market context for SOL-denominated capital and validator economics.

solana_app_fees_usd.caveat: Adapter coverage can change, and fees paid are not money retained by applications.
solana_app_fees_usd.definition: Fees users paid covered Solana applications on the latest complete UTC day, excluding gas, stablecoin issuers, and liquid staking.
solana_app_fees_usd.label: Solana application fees
solana_app_fees_usd.why_it_matters: App fees show what users paid applications for covered services.

solana_app_revenue_usd.caveat: This is not profit; incentives, token emissions, and operating costs are separate.
solana_app_revenue_usd.definition: The portion of covered Solana application fees retained by protocols on the latest complete UTC day.
solana_app_revenue_usd.label: Solana application revenue
solana_app_revenue_usd.why_it_matters: App revenue shows captured value under provider definitions.

solana_chain_fees_usd.caveat: Higher fees can reflect demand, congestion, speculation, or MEV. DeFiLlama's adapter estimates base fees from transaction count although Solana's protocol fee is charged per signature.
solana_chain_fees_usd.definition: Base and priority transaction fees paid to the Solana network on the latest complete UTC day, as indexed by DeFiLlama.
solana_chain_fees_usd.label: Solana chain fees
solana_chain_fees_usd.why_it_matters: Chain fees show demand for scarce transaction execution.

solana_defi_tvl_usd.caveat: TVL depends on protocol coverage and methodology and can double-count economic exposure through composable assets.
solana_defi_tvl_usd.definition: USD value locked in Solana DeFi protocols tracked by DeFiLlama on the latest complete UTC day.
solana_defi_tvl_usd.label: Solana DeFi TVL
solana_defi_tvl_usd.why_it_matters: TVL shows how much capital is deposited in tracked Solana DeFi protocols.

solana_dex_volume_usd.caveat: Routing can touch several pools, and provider adapter and deduplication coverage determine the reported total.
solana_dex_volume_usd.definition: Aggregate Solana spot DEX volume tracked by DeFiLlama on the latest complete UTC day.
solana_dex_volume_usd.label: Solana daily DEX volume
solana_dex_volume_usd.why_it_matters: DEX volume shows how much spot exchange activity occurred across tracked Solana venues.

solana_identifiable_payments_usd.caveat: Raw stablecoin transfers are not payments: they can include trading, bots, rebalancing, and repeated movement.
solana_identifiable_payments_usd.definition: Value transferred for identifiable commerce or remittance, with a published attribution method and coverage boundary.
solana_identifiable_payments_usd.label: Identifiable payment volume
solana_identifiable_payments_usd.why_it_matters: Payments would show use of Solana as financial settlement rather than only trading infrastructure.

solana_monthly_active_developers.caveat: Source not connected: no dependable no-key live export and repository-attribution contract has been verified.
solana_monthly_active_developers.definition: Developers contributing to attributable open-source Solana repositories in a month.
solana_monthly_active_developers.label: Monthly active Solana developers
solana_monthly_active_developers.why_it_matters: It would show the current size of the attributable builder base.

solana_non_stablecoin_rwa_value_usd.caveat: Source not connected: dependable API access requires authentication. No historical article value is substituted.
solana_non_stablecoin_rwa_value_usd.definition: Circulating market value of tokenized real-world assets on Solana, excluding the stablecoin asset class.
solana_non_stablecoin_rwa_value_usd.label: Tokenized real-world assets (excluding stablecoins)

source.method: v4 assets aggregate; Solana; exclude Stablecoins
source.name: RWA.xyz (optional adapter)

solana_non_stablecoin_rwa_value_usd.why_it_matters: This would show adoption of tokenized treasuries, equities, credit, commodities, funds, and other off-chain claims.

solana_retained_developers.caveat: Source not connected: no dependable no-key live export and repository-attribution contract has been verified.
solana_retained_developers.definition: Attributable Solana developers active across a defined prior and current period.
solana_retained_developers.label: Retained Solana developers
solana_retained_developers.why_it_matters: Retention would separate durable building from one-time repository activity.

solana_rev_usd.caveat: REV is not GDP, profit, or app revenue; private or non-Jito MEV may be outside coverage. Jito component: https://api.llama.fi/summary/fees/jito-mev-tips?dataType=dailyFees
solana_rev_usd.definition: Solana chain fees plus gross Jito MEV tips tracked by DeFiLlama for the latest complete UTC day.
solana_rev_usd.label: Solana REV (chain fees + tracked Jito tips)
solana_rev_usd.why_it_matters: REV estimates direct economic value paid for blockspace and transaction ordering.

solana_stablecoin_value_usd.caveat: Circulating stablecoin value is not payment volume or proof that every token is backed by cash.
solana_stablecoin_value_usd.definition: USD value of circulating stablecoins on Solana across DeFiLlama's peg buckets on the latest complete UTC day.
solana_stablecoin_value_usd.label: Solana stablecoin circulating value
solana_stablecoin_value_usd.why_it_matters: Stablecoin value shows the dollar-like liquidity available for trading, saving, and settlement on Solana.

solana_tracked_tvl_categories.caveat: Provider category labels can change and do not measure usage, quality, or economic importance.
solana_tracked_tvl_categories.definition: Distinct DeFiLlama categories among positive-TVL protocol records that include Solana.
solana_tracked_tvl_categories.label: Tracked Solana DeFi categories
solana_tracked_tvl_categories.why_it_matters: Category breadth shows whether activity spans several use cases.

solana_tracked_tvl_protocols.caveat: This is provider coverage, not all Solana apps, active users, developer retention, or product quality.
solana_tracked_tvl_protocols.definition: DeFiLlama protocol records that include Solana and currently report positive TVL.
solana_tracked_tvl_protocols.label: Solana protocols with tracked TVL
solana_tracked_tvl_protocols.why_it_matters: It provides a reproducible lower-bound view of deployed DeFi breadth.

superminority_coefficient.caveat: This is calculated by vote account, not verified independent operator.
superminority_coefficient.definition: Minimum largest vote accounts whose combined activated stake reaches one third.
superminority_coefficient.label: Stake superminority coefficient
superminority_coefficient.why_it_matters: A larger value means more vote accounts are required to reach consensus-blocking stake.

top_10_stake_share_pct.caveat: Vote accounts are not operators; one organization may control several accounts.
top_10_stake_share_pct.definition: Share of activated stake assigned to the ten largest vote accounts.
top_10_stake_share_pct.label: Top 10 stake share
top_10_stake_share_pct.why_it_matters: It exposes concentration hidden by the total validator count.

top_25_stake_share_pct.caveat: Vote accounts are not operators and ownership identity is not inferred.
top_25_stake_share_pct.definition: Share of activated stake assigned to the twenty-five largest vote accounts.
top_25_stake_share_pct.label: Top 25 stake share
top_25_stake_share_pct.why_it_matters: It provides a broader view of stake concentration beyond the largest validators.

vote_credit_coverage_pct.caveat: One credit record is a bounded participation check, not a full performance history.
vote_credit_coverage_pct.definition: Share of active stake on vote accounts whose latest epoch-credit record increased.
vote_credit_coverage_pct.label: Stake with recent vote credits
vote_credit_coverage_pct.why_it_matters: It checks whether active voting power shows evidence of recent vote participation.

summary.headline: The selected Solana RPC endpoint reports healthy.

timeline.fact: Proof of History was conceived in 2017; Solana's genesis block launched Mainnet Beta on March 16, 2020.
timeline.interpretation: The original wager was that cheap, fast shared state could support applications at internet scale.
timeline.title: A faster shared clock becomes a network

timeline.fact: The Solana Foundation reported rapid growth in DeFi, NFTs, validators, and projects during 2021; its historical counts do not include a reproducible methodology.
timeline.interpretation: Demand arrived quickly, making precise definitions of users, projects, and capital essential.
timeline.title: The first application boom

timeline.fact: Solana launched payment and mobile experiments while official incident reports documented consensus-impacting network halts.
timeline.interpretation: Throughput means little without dependable execution, so reliability belongs beside adoption.
timeline.title: Ambition meets reliability

timeline.fact: The Foundation highlighted Helium's migration, state compression, Saga, DeFi recovery, and major commerce and infrastructure integrations.
timeline.interpretation: The recovery case rests on retained builders and widening utility, not token price alone.
timeline.title: Builders carry the recovery

timeline.fact: Foundation and developer reports documented growth across stablecoins, payments, mobile, DePIN, institutions, and new developers.
timeline.interpretation: Solana began looking less like one trading venue and more like a general financial and consumer platform.
timeline.title: Trading broadens into distribution

timeline.fact: A Foundation network report cited nearly 16 months of uptime, multiple validator clients, substantial application revenue, and a voting-power Nakamoto coefficient of 20.
timeline.interpretation: The next test became resilience: diverse software, distributed stake, and sustainable operators.
timeline.title: Reliability and application economics

timeline.fact: Foundation ecosystem reports highlighted expanding stablecoin settlement and tokenized real-world assets; live values require their underlying datasets.
timeline.interpretation: The thesis now is convergence: crypto-native markets meeting payments, tokenized assets, and institutional distribution.
timeline.title: Financial rails move to the foreground

validator_leaderboard.caveat: Ranks are vote accounts, not operators; one organization may control multiple accounts and ownership is not inferred.
